reason: Adds a DSH settings panel for viewing, searching, enabling, disabling, updating, and removing user-installed plugins, with status and source information.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置的插件页面新增“我的插件”面板，用于查看、搜索、启停、更新和移除用户已安装的插件。
summaries.en: Adds a My Plugins panel to DSH settings for viewing, searching, enabling, disabling, updating, and removing installed plugins.

capabilities: Displays installed plugin metadata and runtime status
Enables or disables plugins by modifying profile patch state
Checks GitHub plugin releases and versions
Updates GitHub-sourced plugins through the dsh plugin CLI
Removes installed plugins through the dsh plugin CLI
